title: Show Me All the Ways PLC Activity
sourceOriginalActivity: Activity 1: Represent Our Favorite Numbers; Activity 2: gallery walk
originalTaskSummary: Choose a favorite number BETWEEN 20 AND 100, design an original class-number-book page, show it in several representations including drawings, words, tens/ones and AT LEAST THREE mathematically distinct expressions, then share it at a teacher-organized gallery walk.

teacherRubric.required: Learner independently selects a permitted favorite number and authors a page for the class number book; a generated answer is not evidence of original authorship.
Each stated representation and written equation evaluates to the SAME learner-chosen number within the original 20–100 range.
At least THREE distinct, correct addition expressions represent the same number; different numerical decompositions or additions are mathematically checked.
Page offers more than one representation, including tens/ones models or drawings and clear words/numerals; any first-party alternatives must not imply publisher figures were copied.
Teacher facilitates page exchange and gallery-walk explanations; no pupil page, partner conversation, teacher scoring or real attendance is claimed from numeric Practice.

note: This is source-grounded teacher review preparation within original V1 A–D, not a new approval mechanism or record of completed student work.
